value: This document, presented as a series of FAQs by the Future of Life Institute (FLI), clarifies and justifies their "Pause Giant AI Experiments" open letter. It explains the letter's call for a specific six-month moratorium on training AI models larger than GPT-4, emphasizing this is not a ban on all AI research but a targeted measure to address the rapid, unpredictable progress of advanced AI. The rationale behind the pause encompasses concerns about both potential Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and pressing present harms such as misinformation, bias, and weaponization. The article highlights the intense global reaction to the letter, marked by thousands of high-profile signatories and broad media coverage, underscoring its intent to foster coordination among leading AI labs, alleviate competitive pressures, and generate political will for robust, international governance of AI, drawing parallels to the 1975 Asilomar Conference on recombinant DNA.
